description: Ensure WebSocket connections stay connected and handle reconnection reliably during calls, matching the proven patterns from the web frontend (DeviceContext.jsx).

stories.title: Fly.io Instance Affinity - Store Instance ID
stories.description: When the server sends a call.join.ack or any message containing instanceId, store it in a ref (wsInstanceRef) and persist it to AsyncStorage with key 'device-ws-instance'. This ensures reconnections route to the same Fly.io machine that owns the call session.
stories.acceptance: On receiving any WebSocket message with an instanceId field, update wsInstanceRef.current and write to AsyncStorage. On VoiceContext mount, restore instanceId from AsyncStorage into wsInstanceRef. Clear stored instanceId when call ends (callState becomes 'ended' or 'idle').

stories.title: Fly.io Instance Affinity - Include in WebSocket URL
stories.description: When constructing the WebSocket URL in connectWebSocket(), include fly-force-instance-id as a query parameter if wsInstanceRef.current has a value. This forces Fly.io proxy to route the WebSocket upgrade to the correct machine.
stories.acceptance: connectWebSocket() builds URL as /call/display?callSid={callSid}&fly-force-instance-id={instanceId} when instanceId is available. Without instanceId, connects without the param (first connection). Reconnections always include the stored instanceId.

stories.title: Reconnection Interval - Match Web Frontend
stories.description: Change the reconnection delay from 3000ms to 1500ms to match the web frontend. Call sessions are short-lived and latency matters, so a fixed 1.5s delay is appropriate (not exponential backoff).
stories.acceptance: On unexpected WebSocket close (code !== 1000 and !== 1001), setTimeout calls connectWebSocket() after 1500ms (not 3000ms). The shouldReconnectRef flag still prevents reconnection on intentional close.

stories.title: Heartbeat Interval - Standardize to 25 Seconds
stories.description: Ensure the heartbeat ping interval is 25 seconds in all WebSocket connection code (VoiceContext and useDisplaySocket). The web frontend uses 25s which keeps connections alive through load balancers without being too aggressive.
stories.acceptance: VoiceContext connectWebSocket() sends { type: 'ping', ts: Date.now() } every 25 seconds via setInterval. useDisplaySocket also uses 25s interval. Heartbeat starts on socket open, clears on socket close/error.

stories.title: Duplicate Connection Prevention
stories.description: Before creating a new WebSocket, check if an existing connection is already open or connecting to the same URL. This prevents duplicate connections from React re-renders or rapid state changes.
stories.acceptance: connectWebSocket() checks: (1) wsRef.current exists, (2) readyState is OPEN or CONNECTING, (3) the target URL matches what we would connect to. If all three are true, return without creating a new connection. Store target URL on the socket object for comparison.

stories.title: App State Handling - Reconnect on Foreground
stories.description: When the app returns to foreground from background, check if the WebSocket is still connected. If not (and call is still active), trigger reconnection. This handles iOS/Android suspending background connections.
stories.acceptance: VoiceContext registers an AppState change listener. When state changes from 'background' to 'active' and callSid exists and callState is 'active'/'call-ringing'/'dialing', check wsRef.current.readyState. If not OPEN, call connectWebSocket(). On unmount, remove AppState listener.

stories.title: Connection Lifecycle - Tie to Call State
stories.description: WebSocket should only be connected when callSid exists AND callState is not 'idle' or 'ended'. On state transition to idle/ended, set shouldReconnectRef to false and close with code 1000. This matches the web frontend's useEffect pattern.
stories.acceptance: useEffect watches callSid and callState. If callSid && callState !== 'idle' && callState !== 'ended': set shouldReconnectRef = true, call connectWebSocket(). Else: call closeWebSocket() which sets shouldReconnectRef = false, clears heartbeat, closes socket with code 1000.

stories.title: State Sync on Reconnect
stories.description: When the WebSocket reconnects mid-call, the server sends call.join.ack followed by translation-state-sync. Handle translation-state-sync to update isTranslating, srcLang, and dstLang state so UI renders correctly even if events were missed during disconnect.
stories.acceptance: On receiving translation-state-sync message, update isTranslating state and store srcLang/dstLang. On receiving call.join.ack, log successful reconnection. These messages ensure the UI is consistent after any reconnection gap.

stories.title: Reconnection Guard - Only During Active Call States
stories.description: The shouldReconnectRef flag must be checked before any reconnection attempt. Reconnection should only happen when callState is 'active', 'call-ringing', or 'dialing'. If call has ended while socket was disconnected, do not attempt reconnection.
stories.acceptance: In the socket close handler, before scheduling reconnection: verify shouldReconnectRef.current is true AND callState is in ['active', 'call-ringing', 'dialing']. If either check fails, do not reconnect. On end-call message, set shouldReconnectRef = false before closing.

stories.title: Clean Disconnect on Call End
stories.description: When receiving end-call WebSocket message or when user ends call locally, perform a clean disconnect: set shouldReconnectRef to false, clear heartbeat interval, close WebSocket with code 1000, clear instanceId from AsyncStorage, and null out wsRef.
stories.acceptance: handleEndCall() or end-call message handler: sets shouldReconnectRef = false, clearInterval(heartbeatRef), closes ws with code 1000 if readyState is OPEN/CONNECTING, removes 'device-ws-instance' from AsyncStorage, sets wsRef.current = null. No reconnection attempts fire after this.

stories.title: WebSocket Message Protocol - Full Message Support
stories.description: Handle all message types from the server: call.join.ack, translation-state-sync, call-initiated, call-ringing, call-answered, call-connecting-customer, transcript, toggle-translation.ack, control.applied, answering-machine, end-call, pong. Send: call.join, ping, translation-on, translation-off.
stories.acceptance: Message handler switch/if-chain covers all listed types. call-initiated sets callState 'dialing'. call-ringing sets 'call-ringing'. call-answered sets 'active' and updates language state. transcript appends to transcript array. end-call triggers clean disconnect. toggle-translation.ack updates isTranslating. pong is logged/ignored.

stories.title: Consolidate WebSocket to Single Implementation
stories.description: Remove websocket.service.ts and useWebSocket.ts (legacy generic implementations). Use VoiceContext's connectWebSocket as the single WebSocket connection manager for calls. useDisplaySocket.ts can remain for display-only monitoring but should align intervals (25s heartbeat, 1.5s reconnect).
stories.acceptance: VoiceContext owns all call WebSocket logic. websocket.service.ts and useWebSocket.ts are removed or deprecated. useDisplaySocket.ts updated to use 25s heartbeat and 1.5s reconnect. No duplicate WebSocket connections during a call.
